name: Uranium, next two

sprites.name: Orchynx
sprites.note: Back redrawn at the front's scale. Materials, going by its type (Grass/Steel) and art: the green coat and the lime stripes and face are fur; the tail-tip ring and the claw caps are steel. Motion: when it crouches, the back now drops its head and tail tip as far as the front does; before, it barely moved.

sprites.name: Chyinmunk
sprites.note: Back redrawn at the front's scale. Materials: the tan coat and the blue ear tips, cheek pouches, belly and tail brush are all fur; the eyes and teeth have a little shine. Its Pokédex text gives nothing more to go on, so nothing glows. The back already made the same moves as the front, so its motion is unchanged.

note: First look at the last two of the first Uranium sprites: Orchynx and Chyinmunk, both redone in the Gen 5 layout and lit.
